name: servvo-ntt
description: Website distributor APAR SERVVO NTT - monorepo client (React+Vite) & server (Express+Prisma)

scripts.postinstall: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c red,green "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix client run build && npm --prefix server run build
scripts.lint: npm --prefix client run lint && npm --prefix server run lint
